name: Build a Telegram bot
description: Telegram bots are a powerful business tool. I will show how to create a bot for order automation, customer support, or lead collection. We will look at real cases and optimize your business processes.

name: German from scratch
description: I know German perfectly. I will teach you to speak like a sweet milkmaid — or like a grouchy old housekeeper.

name: How to hold an audience’s attention
description: Teaching is emotional labor. I will share techniques for keeping energy and motivation across decades of a career. I will show how to turn routine into a creative process and avoid professional deformation.

name: Plants for the lazy and very busy
description: I will teach you to care not only for cacti, but also for the fussiest orchids!

name: Violin for beginners: from bow to melody
description: A unique course for the brave: violin basics and voice training. You will see how these two skills reinforce each other (intonation, rhythm, breathing). Learn to accompany yourself or simply open two new worlds of expression. For complete beginners in both arts.

name: Ratatouille and more: the magic of seasonal vegetables
description: Food should delight the eye. I will teach you not only to cook, but also to plate beautifully. Simple restaurant presentation techniques at home. How to roll a spring roll so it crunches, and stack a burger so it begs for Instagram. We will turn every dinner into a small performance.

name: Northern meditation: silence and inner light
description: Yoga is not boring. It is a superpower for managing mood, energy, and attention. I will teach simple but powerful practices you can do even in a dorm: back asanas after long sitting, breathing before something important, 5-minute meditations for a reset. No esoterics — only tools that work.

name: Home repair without panic: first steps for beginners
description: A basic course for people who can tell a screwdriver from pliers but are afraid to use them. We will learn to: 1) assemble and disassemble furniture with and without instructions, 2) hang shelves, pictures, and lights evenly and securely, 3) replace sockets and switches (with full safety), 4) fix small household issues. No fluff — only concrete skills and confidence in your hands.

name: Painting light: oil painting basics
description: A course on oil painting basics. From underpainting to glazes. We learn from the old masters: how to build composition, mix paints on the palette, and work with tone and color. We copy fragments of Impressionists — the best way to understand the magic of light and color.

name: Hidden tyranny
description: Control people.

name: Negotiations without defeat: from tactics to strategy
description: Are you being pressured, blackmailed, or presented with a fait accompli? We will learn to push back. We will unpack unfair tactics: good cop / bad cop, fake deadlines, guilt pressure. And most importantly — we will practice elegant and firm counter-strategies. You will stop being a pawn in someone else’s game.

name: React from scratch
description: I will level up your frontend skills. We will cover hooks, state, routing, and everything you need to work confidently with React. I will teach you not just to write code, but to think like a developer and build scalable apps.

name: Intuitive eating
description: How to stop living on diets and start living. We will unpack nutrition myths, learn to listen to your body, and build a healthy relationship with food without bans and binge cycles.

name: A house of wood
description: Designing and building wooden houses. I will talk about choosing materials, assembly techniques, and typical beginner mistakes. I will help you design a dream house wisely and without extra costs.

name: Business English
description: English for work and career. I will teach you to write business emails, give presentations, and communicate confidently with international partners. We will look at real cases from international business.

name: French cuisine
description: Secrets of haute cuisine for home. I will teach you to make perfect onion soup, croissants, and sauces that turn an ordinary dish into a masterpiece. No magic — only technique and quality ingredients.

name: Zumba for the soul
description: Dances that heal. Zumba is not just fitness, but a way to release emotions and charge up with energy. We will learn simple combinations to fiery music. A huge smile is guaranteed!

name: Digital hygiene
description: Protect your data online. I will talk about passwords, two-factor authentication, phishing, and how not to become a scam victim. A special course for your parents — a gift that will protect them from hacks.

name: A windowsill garden
description: Greens and vegetables all year round. I will tell you what to plant, how to care for it, and how to harvest even in winter. Microgreens, cherry tomatoes, peppers — all of this can grow in your kitchen.

name: Phone portraits
description: How to take beautiful portraits without a DSLR. Light, posing, angles, and editing right on the phone. After the course your friends will keep asking you to photograph them.

name: Anti-anxiety
description: Cognitive behavioral therapy for self-work. I will teach techniques that help with anxious thoughts, panic attacks, and finding an inner foothold. We work with beliefs and fears.

name: Furniture restoration
description: Give things a second life. I will show how to restore an old chest of drawers, refresh a chair, or paint a wardrobe so it becomes an art object. Budget savings and a unique interior guaranteed.

name: The voice of your dreams
description: Voice training for life and work. I will teach you to speak so people listen with full attention. We will release tension, set breathing, and make your voice your main instrument of influence.

name: Investing
description: Where an investor should start. I will talk about stocks, bonds, funds, and risks. I will help you build a first portfolio and not lose money at the start. No fluff and no complicated jargon.

name: Home floristry
description: How to compose bouquets that look expensive. I will teach combining colors and textures and caring for cut flowers. Make your gifts unforgettable.

name: Marathon from scratch
description: Preparing for a first marathon. I will talk about a training plan, gear, nutrition, and recovery. I will help you run the distance without injuries and with pleasure. Running changes life!

name: Makeup in 15 minutes
description: Everyday makeup that highlights your features. I will teach a fast, beautiful look that makes you feel confident. No masks — only natural beauty.

name: Informal Saint Petersburg
description: Tours of non-obvious places in Saint Petersburg. I will show courtyards, stairwells, and rooftops that guidebooks skip. You will see the city from another side and fall in love with it again.

name: Design for living
description: How to make an interior cozy without a designer. I will talk about layout, color, light, and zoning. I will help organize space so you want to live in it, not just exist there.

name: Yoga for everyone
description: Hatha yoga for beginners. I will teach basic asanas, breathing practices, and meditation. Yoga will become your island of calm in a noisy world. We work at a comfortable pace.

name: The potter’s wheel
description: Clay heals. I will teach working at the wheel, creating simple forms, and feeling the material. This is not about mastery, but about flow and the pleasure of making things with your hands.

name: Mobile photography
description: Shoot like a pro on a phone. Composition, light, color, and simple hacks for great shots in travel and everyday life. Your Instagram will glow!

name: Copy that sells
description: Copywriting for social media and blogs. I will teach engaging texts people want to read to the end. We will cover post structure, headlines, and attention-holding techniques.

name: IT for small business
description: How to set up small-business IT infrastructure without extra costs. I will help choose hardware, set up software, and automate routine work. Stop paying for things you can do for free.

name: Event management
description: How to organize an event people will remember. Timing, vendors, budget, stress, and unexpected situations. I will walk you through every preparation stage and teach you not to fear force majeure.

name: Figma for beginners
description: Interface design from scratch. I will teach Figma, prototypes, and mockups for sites and apps. After the course you will be able to design your own project or start a career in IT.

name: Style on a budget
description: How to look expensive on any budget. I will teach building a capsule wardrobe, combining pieces, and finding quality clothes at reasonable prices. Shopping accompaniment and wardrobe reviews.

name: Tennis
description: Tennis for amateurs. Stroke technique, footwork, tactics. Training for any level. Tennis is chess on a court — I will teach you to think and win.

name: Spanish for life
description: Conversational Spanish with cultural immersion. I will teach not only the language, but how to think and feel in Spanish. We cook paella, watch series, and discuss traditions.

name: 1C from scratch
description: 1C for accountants and entrepreneurs. I will teach you not to fear the software, post entries, close a period, and generate reports. Understand 1C and stop paying programmers for trivia.

name: Adolescent psychology
description: How to find a common language with a teenager. For parents and teachers. I will talk about age crises, bullying, gadgets, and motivation. I will help build trusting relationships with children.

name: Karate for kids
description: Karate for the youngest. Discipline, respect, physical development, and the ability to stand up for yourself. Training in a playful form, without harshness, with attention to every child.

name: Garden design
description: Creating a dream garden. I will talk about plot layout, plant selection, care, and decor. Turn an ordinary plot into a place of strength where you want to spend every free minute.

name: Decoupage and craquelure
description: Decorating interior objects with decoupage. We will refresh an old chest of drawers, turn a boring vase into an art object, and create unique pieces for the home. Creativity without limits.

name: Knitting for beginners
description: From scratch to a first sweater. Casting on, knit and purl, patterns and decreases. Knitting calms the nerves and gives cozy things warmed by your hands.

name: Snowboard for beginners
description: First steps on a snowboard. I will teach standing up, braking, turning, and enjoying the slide. We will overcome the fear of speed and fall in love with the mountains. An individual approach for everyone.

name: Beautiful speech
description: Sound production and work with speech issues. For children and adults. I will teach speaking clearly, beautifully, and confidently. We will work on lisps, rhotacism, and fear of public speaking.

name: Phone repair
description: DIY gadget repair. I will teach replacing screens, batteries, and connectors, and diagnosing failures. Save on repairs and help friends. Gadgets will stop being a mystery.

name: Zero waste for life
description: A more ecological lifestyle without fanaticism. I will talk about waste sorting, reusable alternatives, and how to reduce trash without turning life into a battle for the planet. We start small.

name: Wine culture
description: Wine literacy for everyone. I will teach how to understand wine, choose it in a shop, and pair it with food. Friendly tastings without snobbery or fancy jargon. Simple talk about a complex subject.

name: Wedding floristry
description: A bridal bouquet and floral wedding styling. I will talk about trends, combinations, and flower longevity. I will help create the atmosphere of your celebration with floristry. Dreams come true!

name: Mentoring in IT
description: I will help you enter IT and not burn out. Code review, interview prep, career advice. I will take you from beginner to a first offer. IT is simple when you have a mentor.

name: Art therapy
description: Drawing as a way to cope with stress. No rules and no grades — only process and emotions. I will help express feelings through creativity and find an inner resource. We heal the soul with paint.

name: Fishing for beginners
description: Everything about fishing from A to Z. Gear, lures, spots, and secrets of experienced anglers. I organize trips into nature and teach how to enjoy the process. Fishing is the best meditation.

name: Pattern cutting and sewing
description: We will sew your first garment. From taking measurements to a finished piece. I will teach using a sewing machine, reading patterns, and bringing ideas to life. Clothes that fit perfectly.

name: Woodworking
description: Working with wood for beginners. We will learn hand and power tools and make simple furniture. Wood is a warm material you want to touch. Let’s make something with our own hands.

name: Handmade tapestry
description: Frame weaving. We will create an original tapestry that will decorate your home. Working with different textures, colors, and materials. Creativity that calms and inspires.

name: Chess for kids
description: We teach chess from scratch. We develop logic, memory, and persistence. An individual approach to every child. Chess teaches thinking several moves ahead — a skill that helps in life.

name: Early development
description: Sessions with children from age 1. I will help mothers organize a developmental environment at home and choose games and toys. We grow and learn together through play and communication.

name: Cars for beginners
description: What every driver needs to know. I will teach basic diagnostics, changing wheels, and checking oil and other fluids. Stop being afraid to open the hood and be ready for surprises on the road.

name: Calligraphy for everyone
description: Beautiful handwriting in 10 sessions. We will correct handwriting for children and adults and learn to write neatly with pleasure. In the gadget age, writing beautifully becomes a superpower.

name: Tea ceremony
description: The way of tea. I will teach understanding varieties, brewing properly, and tasting. A tea ceremony as a way to slow down and be in the moment. We drink tea and talk about life.

name: Piano for adults
description: It is never too late to start playing. I will teach the basics, we will work through your favorite melodies, and simply enjoy music. For those who always dreamed but were afraid to begin.

name: Contextual advertising
description: Setting up Yandex Direct and Google Ads. I will teach you not to waste budgets, collect keywords, and analyze results. Bring in clients instead of just spending money. Marketing that works.

name: Exotic garden
description: Growing exotics in a temperate climate. I will talk about lemons, pomegranates, feijoa, and other plants that can grow in your garden or home. Care and wintering secrets. Surprise the neighbors!

name: Swimming for adults
description: Learn to swim from scratch or improve technique. Work with people who fear water. An individual approach, support, and results. Swimming is the best sport for health and longevity.

name: Natural soap
description: Soap making for beginners. We will create handmade soap with natural ingredients. Ideas for gifts and home use. Chemistry that becomes creativity.

name: Designing a house
description: How to design your dream house. I will talk about architectural styles, layouts, engineering systems, and materials. I will help avoid typical mistakes and create a project that is comfortable to live in.

name: Home skincare
description: Skincare at home. I will teach how to understand ingredients, choose cosmetics, and do simple treatments. Beautiful skin without injections and expensive salons is possible.

name: Speech technique
description: The voice as an instrument of influence. Breathing, releasing tension, diction. For people who talk a lot and want to sound convincing. Your voice is your superpower.

name: Food photography
description: How to shoot food so you want to eat the screen. Light, angles, composition, and phone editing. For bloggers and anyone who wants to photograph their dishes beautifully.

name: Video editing in DaVinci
description: Video editing for YouTube and social media. I will teach DaVinci Resolve, color correction, and effects. Your videos will look professional even without an expensive camera.

name: Custom cakes
description: Pastry arts for home. I will teach baking sponges, making creams, and assembling cakes that look store-bought but taste a hundred times better. Surprise your loved ones for a celebration.

name: English for IT professionals
description: Technical English for work. We read documentation, pass interviews, and talk with clients. Only what is actually needed in IT, without extra grammar and boring exercises.

name: Patchwork
description: Patchwork for beginners. We will create cozy quilts, pillows, and throws from scraps. Creativity that warms and gives favorite fabrics a second life. Every scrap is a story.

name: Functional training
description: Training for strength and health. Individual programs without injuries, considering your goals and specifics. Preparation for competitions or simply a fit body without obsession.

name: Capsule wardrobe
description: Building a wardrobe that works. I will teach choosing a base, combining pieces, and looking stylish every day. Shopping without stress and extra spending. Fewer items — more outfits.

name: Appliance repair
description: DIY home-appliance repair. Diagnostics, part replacement, prevention. Save on technicians and extend the life of your appliances. Refrigerators, washers, coffee machines — we will fix it all.

name: Stained glass painting
description: Painting on glass. We will create stained glass, paint dishes and mirrors. Sunbeams and bright colors in your home. Creativity that transforms a space.

name: SMM from scratch
description: Running social media for businesses and bloggers. I will teach creating content, analyzing stats, and selling through posts. Instagram, VK, Telegram — a full toolkit.

name: Manicure for yourself
description: A beautiful manicure at home. I will teach gel polish, design, and cuticle care. Save on salons and always look well-groomed.

name: Neural networks for life
description: AI tools for everyday tasks. I will teach writing prompts and generating images, texts, and ideas. Neural networks will not replace you, but they will make your work ten times faster.

name: Hand weaving
description: Weaving tapestries and rugs on a loom. Meditative creativity that slows you down and calms you. We will create a unique piece for your home that will warm long evenings.

name: Boxing for amateurs
description: Punch technique, defense, footwork. Training for body and soul. Boxing relieves stress and builds confidence. Come let off steam and learn to defend yourself.

name: Medicinal herbs
description: Gathering and preparing herbs. I will teach recognizing plants, harvesting them at the right time, and making useful blends. Nature gives everything for health — you just need to know where to look.

name: Blacksmithing
description: Basics of working with metal. We will make a knife, a stand, or a piece of jewelry with our own hands. Metal can be warm if you put soul into it. The magic of fire and hammer.

name: Bobbin lace
description: The old art of lace making. Delicate, painstaking work that fascinates. We will create lace napkins and collars that will be passed down as heirlooms.

name: Sound design
description: Creating music and sounds for video and games. Working in a DAW, recording, processing, and mixing. Let’s make sound that catches. For bloggers, directors, and creative people.

name: Holiday decor
description: Styling birthdays and weddings with your own hands. I will teach how to make it beautiful without a huge budget. Balloons, flowers, fabrics — we create mood and magic.

name: Excel for life
description: Spreadsheets that work. I will teach formulas, pivot tables, macros, and automation. Stop counting on your fingers and make Excel work for you. For accounting, planning, and analytics.

name: Illustration in Procreate
description: Drawing on iPad. I will teach Procreate and creating illustrations for social media and for yourself. Digital creativity without limits. For beginners and those who want to level up.

name: Philosophy club
description: Conversations that matter. We discuss texts, learn to think critically, and formulate ideas. Philosophy is not for dusty libraries, but for life. We look for answers to eternal questions.

name: Fitness for moms
description: Postpartum recovery. I will help you get back in shape, strengthen muscles, and love your body. Training that considers specifics and does not harm health. For mothers who take care of themselves.

name: Book restoration
description: Bringing old books back to life. I will teach cleaning, gluing, and restoring bindings. Give family heirlooms a second life. Books will live forever.

name: Choreography
description: Dance basics for beginners. Body placement, stretching, musicality. We will learn combinations and simply enjoy movement. Dance is a language the soul speaks.

name: Metal forging
description: Blacksmithing basics. We will create simple interior objects from metal. Forge, hammer, and anvil — feel like a real blacksmith. Metal in your hands will become pliable.

name: Astrology for yourself
description: Reading a natal chart. I will teach astrology basics so you can better understand yourself and your talents. Astrology as a self-knowledge tool, not fortune-telling.

name: Game design
description: Inventing games. Mechanics, scenarios, playtesting. We will create a prototype of a board or computer game. For people who want to make games, not only play them. Creativity and systems thinking.

name: Beadwork
description: Handmade bead jewelry. We will weave bracelets, earrings, and necklaces that look designer-made. Fine motor skills, meditation, and beautiful gifts for yourself and loved ones.

name: Forest survival
description: Survival skills for city dwellers. Navigation, fire-making, finding water, shelter. Outdoor trainings in nature. What everyone should know, even if they live in a megacity.
